score_source: Existing processed_transactions.result.score; no calculation in browser
score_semantics: 0 is a real assessment; null/missing remains Not assessed; score is rule points, not fraud probability.
ui: Compact light workspace, dark FinTrust navigation, metrics, chart grid, risk distribution, readable score column, sortable page rows, contained mobile tables, existing investigation drawer.
scope: No fake dashboard date/account filters: assigned accounts/all dates shown; existing scoped Insights filters linked.
test_servers: Temporary loopback servers shut down by fixture
design_boundary: Use screenshots and official site for interaction inspiration; retain FinTrust identity. No imported logo, copied icons, CSS or pixel layout.
verification_boundary: Focused local SQL/browser tests, not a repeated full regression or Linux/cloud gate.
